mealAnalysis.guidance_message: This appears to be a mixed green salad with lettuce and yellow bell pepper, which is low in simple carbohydrates and generally has a low glycemic impact on blood sugar levels for someone with diabetes. It is best to choose this type of meal regularly, and if adding toppings or dressing, opt for high-fiber vegetables and minimal added sugar instead.
mealAnalysis.meal_title: Mixed Lettuce and Bell Pepper Salad
mealAnalysis.meal_description: A simple salad composed primarily of mixed lettuce leaves with diced yellow bell pepper and no clearly visible high-carbohydrate additions.
